description: This file defines the AliasDb class for alias analysis within PyTorch's JIT compiler, including methods for tracking aliasing, mutation, and graph analysis, as well as related classes and utilities.

classes.name: AliasDb
classes.description: Performs alias analysis on computation graphs, tracking mutable and immutable values, alias sets, and mutation safety.

classes.name: ValueAndMemoryLocationSet
classes.description: A set of values with associated memory locations, used for efficient aliasing queries.

methods.name: AliasDb
methods.description: Constructor for AliasDb, initializes alias analysis for a given graph.

methods.name: writesToWildcard
methods.description: Checks if a node writes to a wildcard (uncertain) alias set.

methods.name: writesToAlias
methods.description: Checks if a node writes to an alias of specified values.

methods.name: mayContainAlias
methods.description: Determines if two values or groups of values may alias.

methods.name: mayAlias
methods.description: Checks if two values or groups of values may share memory locations.

methods.name: hasInputWriters
methods.description: Checks if any node writes to an alias set input of a given node.

methods.name: hasOutputWriters
methods.description: Checks if any node writes to an alias set output of a given node.

methods.name: isMutable
methods.description: Determines if a node performs in-place mutation.

methods.name: moveAfterTopologicallyValid
methods.description: Attempts to move a node after another node in topological order safely.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Prints the alias database state for debugging.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the alias database.

methods.name: dumpToGraphvizFile
methods.description: Exports the alias graph to a Graphviz DOT file.

methods.name: isMutableType
methods.description: Checks if a value or type is mutable.

methods.name: replaceWithNewValue
methods.description: Updates aliasing info to replace an old value with a new one.

methods.name: createValue
methods.description: Creates a new value with no aliases.
